# Top-10 triage plan — `01-messy-ts-app`

Ordered within each bucket by what unblocks the most agent/human edits per minute of work. Top-10 = the 10 highest-`agent_risk` findings from the scan (crime_00001 → crime_00010).

## Structural / correctness (6 findings)

| # | ID | Charge | File | Action | Why |
|---|----|--------|------|--------|-----|
| 1 | crime_00007 | Dev-Server URL | `src/api/files.ts:8` | **Fix now** | One-line lift to env var. Literal silently breaks every non-dev env. |
| 2 | crime_00008 | Localhost-on-Disk | `src/api/files.ts:9` | **Fix now** | `/Users/andrew/...` — fails on every other machine + CI. Quick swap to `os.homedir()`/config. |
| 3 | crime_00009 | Timezone Roulette | `src/date.ts:29,33` | **Fix now** | Two unmarked date literals — real correctness bug, append `Z`. |
| 4 | crime_00003 | Half-UTC, Half-Local | `src/date.ts:9,41` | **Fix now** | Same file as #3 and #6 — batch the date.ts pass. Pick UTC, convert at boundary. |
| 5 | crime_00002 | Temporal Recklessness | `src/date.ts:4-40` | **Fix now** | 8 direct `Date.now()`/`new Date()` in the same `date.ts` already being touched — inject a clock in the same PR. |
| 6 | crime_00005 | God Function `generateInvoice` | `src/billing.ts:50-253` | **Defer** | 204-line orchestrator. High-confidence finding but the safe refactor wants the duplication/literal cleanup (#9) landed first, plus tests. Fold in next time billing is touched. |

## IA / agent-readability (2 findings)

| # | ID | Charge | File | Action | Why |
|---|----|--------|------|--------|-----|
| 7 | crime_00006 | Missing Agent Context | repo root | **Fix now** | Cheap meta-fix. Writing `AGENTS.md` (or `CLAUDE.md`) costs minutes and de-risks every subsequent agent edit, including the rest of this triage. Do this first if a coding agent will execute the plan. |
| 8 | crime_00004 | Concept Alias Drift (tenant/account/org/team/workspace) | `docs/billing.md` +4 files | **Defer** | Needs a glossary decision before renames — not safe for an agent to unilaterally collapse. Park behind a "canonical term = ?" question for the humans. |

| # | ID | Charge | File | Action | Why |
|---|----|--------|------|--------|-----|
| 9 | crime_00010 | String Sprinkles `"enterprise"` | `src/api/plan.ts` +3 files | **Defer** | Real signal (4 areas, becomes duplicated policy) but cross-cutting. Promote to a `PLANS.ENTERPRISE` constant the next time billing/plan code is touched — ideally in the same PR as the God Function split (#6). |

## Frontend / asset (1 finding)

| # | ID | Charge | File | Action | Why |
|---|----|--------|------|--------|-----|
| 10 | crime_00001 | SVG With Embedded Raster | `src/assets/partner-logo.svg` | **Fix now** | Highest `agent_risk` (0.70) and isolated — re-export from design tool or split the raster out. No code dependencies, parallelizable with the date.ts work. |

## Git-history (0 findings)

No churn data in this scan (every `churn`/`recency` score is 0 — looks like the fixture has no git history). Nothing to triage here; revisit after `crimes hotspots` runs against a real history.

---

## Recommended execution order

1. **crime_00006** (write `AGENTS.md`) — 10 min, unblocks the rest.
2. **crime_00007 + crime_00008** (one PR, `src/api/files.ts` env/path) — 15 min.
3. **crime_00001** (SVG re-export) — designer task, fire in parallel.
4. **crime_00002 + crime_00003 + crime_00009** (one PR — full `src/date.ts` cleanup: clock injection + UTC unification + explicit-zone parses) — half-day.
5. **Defer #6, #8, #9** to the next billing/IA touch; capture #8 as a glossary question before any rename lands.

Nothing in the top 10 is **ignore**-worthy — every finding has concrete evidence and a low-risk fix shape.
